<h2>Coverage and method</h2>
<p class="gm-method">Western holder data for thermal coal is not held. The CZCE contract changed code from TC to ZC in March 2016 and last traded in December 2022; the series is a closed record.</p>
<p class="gm-method">Sector: Energy, Coal. Units print per row and are never converted. Category definitions are each source's own. Pages render the current corrected vintage of each source; first-release vintages are not kept. An extreme reading is a condition of crowding, not a buy or sell signal.</p>
